ideal_consequence_proof: At y-deficit r<=K the ordinary T2 coefficient is -q*A1_(x,K-r) modulo earlier A1 coefficients of deficit<r. Every higher A/B block has deficit>=K+1; alpha1 powers and h corrections have an earlier A1 factor. At r=K the additional gamma_top is scalar, so only its charge0 coefficient survives. Constant nonzero pivots -q prove UX subset U as ideals. For W<K stop at W-1 and then use positive-x scalar-leader rows at W.
admissible_use: A separate necessary realization refinement may adjoin UX to I_J plus c and lambda localizers. Replacing lambda by lambda_UX and every Jacobian row by its image is exact only with UX retained or the explicit quotient isomorphism declared. This is not an equivalence to the original baseline without U; a unit still needs cofactor lifting through these maps.
